test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: BJTI is related to EMWL in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, HDRL is related to KGUO. To which of the following is OCGM related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• BJTI is written as EMWL

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bae76f51a70d20c2911cf137ce7fa96f8c25d4b389f79e4782a9a737a5aa2bc2.png] 

And,

 
• HDRL is written as KGUO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/826637b236c256fb84d2a1e587ab3bdedaa5d6c86b3434cb6f7d8aff10c4829d.png] 

Similarly,

 
• OCGM is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44c2cc70919541d436fca241815840f7298795f53735da449765f80aa047c2ed.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**RFJP**".

e4:T
